"**Turn Me On**" is a song by John D. Loudermilk that was first recorded and released by Mark Dinning in 1961 as the B-side to his single "Lonely Island". Other notable versions are by Nellie Rutherford and Nina Simone.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turn_Me_On_(Mark_Dinning_song)#cite_note-5)Norah Jones released her version as the last single from her debut album _Come Away with Me_ on May 12, 2003. The song was also performed by Shelby Dressel during her _American Idol_ audition.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turn_Me_On_(Mark_Dinning_song)#cite_note-6)
Musicologist Joe Hickerson suggested that "Turn Me On" influenced the composition of Leonard Cohen's 1969 song "Bird on the Wire".[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turn_Me_On_(Mark_Dinning_song)#cite_note-7)

## Norah Jones version
[edit]
Jones's cover was the seventh track on her debut album. This version also appeared in the soundtrack of the movie _Love Actually_.

"**Turn Me On**" is a song by John D. Loudermilk that was first recorded and released by Mark Dinning in 1961 as the B-side to his single "Lonely Island". Other notable versions are by Nellie Rutherford and Nina Simone.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turn_Me_On_(Mark_Dinning_song)#cite_note-5)Norah Jones released her version as the last single from her debut album _Come Away with Me_ on May 12, 2003. The song was also performed by Shelby Dressel during her _American Idol_ audition.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turn_Me_On_(Mark_Dinning_song)#cite_note-6)
Musicologist Joe Hickerson suggested that "Turn Me On" influenced the composition of Leonard Cohen's 1969 song "Bird on the Wire".[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turn_Me_On_(Mark_Dinning_song)#cite_note-7)
